pre.style: color: #94a3b8; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.5;

foreignObject.pre:
sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User as User / App participant Central as Central (Web Client) participant Peripheral as Peripheral (Sensor)
Note over Peripheral: GAP: Advertising on CH 37, 38, 39 Peripheral->>Central: ADV_IND (Heart Rate 0x180D, RSSI -64dBm) User->>Central: Click Connect Central->>Peripheral: CONNECT_IND (Interval 20ms, Latency 0, Timeout 4s) Note over Central,Peripheral: Jump to Data Channels (FHSS Locked)
Central->>Peripheral: ATT_EXCHANGE_MTU_REQ (Client MTU: 247) Peripheral->>Central: ATT_EXCHANGE_MTU_RSP (Server MTU: 247)
Central->>Peripheral: ATT_READ_REQ [Handle 0x2A19: Battery Level] Peripheral->>Central: ATT_READ_RSP [Value: 0x5C (92%)]
Central->>Peripheral: ATT_WRITE_REQ [Handle 0x2902: CCCD = 0x0001] Peripheral->>Central: ATT_WRITE_RSP [Write Success]
loop Every 1000ms (Stream) Peripheral->>Central: ATT_HANDLE_VALUE_NTF [0x2A37: Flags, BPM, RR] Note over Central: Live ECG Waveform Chart Updated! end
